slides.main: Reacting to bread? It's not always the gluten.
slides.sub: Why the coeliac test comes first, and what else in wheat can cause symptoms.

slides.main: Coeliac disease, wheat allergy and gluten sensitivity are not the same.
slides.sub: Coeliac disease damages the small intestine. Gluten sensitivity can feel similar but does not.

slides.main: Don't cut out gluten before a coeliac test.
slides.sub: Tests are only accurate while you eat gluten. Already cut down? Ask your GP before testing.

slides.main: In one trial, fructans caused more symptoms than gluten.
slides.sub: 59 people who avoided gluten. Gluten caused no more symptoms than placebo. One small study.

slides.main: Expecting gluten to harm you can cause real symptoms.
slides.sub: A review found fermentable carbs and this nocebo effect contribute considerably in many cases.

slides.main: Get medical help if you have:
items: Blood in your stool or black stools
Coeliac disease or IBD in your family
